title: The Swiss vote on neutrality – level 1
paragraphs: People in Switzerland say no to new neutrality rules. Most people vote against an idea from a right-wing party.

The new rules want to stop Switzerland from working with NATO or using economic sanctions during wars. The Swiss government wants to be free and decide how it needs to. People are happy with how things are now. Swiss people want to stay friends with other European countries and help Ukraine.
Switzerland wants to keep its current system. But if a big war starts near Europe, Switzerland may have to think about its safety again.

words.d: when you do not take sides in a conflict or war
